name: a_member_s_reply_contradicts_the_admin
use_case: Pick up a billing request that arrived by email
branch: Admin asks to process email request from thread th_s403_seat_request where a member contradicts admin's 9 seat request with 12 seats
tests: Reads thread, adheres to billing admin's request of 9 seats ignoring member's message, and schedules plan change
instruction:
You are Carol Cloud, billing administrator for CloudScale (Tenant ID: T03, User ID: U03_ADMIN). You previously sent an email requesting 9 seats on Basic from next period in thread th_s403_seat_request. A member on your team (Charlie User) replied on that thread asking for 12 seats instead. You are now contacting the billing desk directly to confirm that your request for 9 seats is the authorized one, and you want them to preview and schedule 9 seats on Basic effective at the end of the period.

Your details:
- Tenant ID: T03
- User ID: U03_ADMIN
- Email Thread ID: th_s403_seat_request
- Authorized Request: 9 seats on Basic (end of period)

persona.name: Carol Cloud
persona.initial_message: Hi, I'm Carol Cloud from CloudScale (T03, U03_ADMIN). We sent a seat request in email thread th_s403_seat_request. Please review the thread, ignore the member's message, and schedule 9 seats on Basic for our next billing period.

fixed.threadId: the email the request came in
